title: Copilot Studio: self-learning recommendations to refine agents
summary: Hold: the briefing treats agent-flow billing as the mechanism behind self-learning without evidence that the planned workflows are agent flows. It also overstates the absence of administrative involvement and controls, and adds unverified details about separate agent definitions and identical workflow failures.

claims.claim: The monthly agent limit is configured in Power Platform admin center through Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio.
2. Select Manage Agents.
3. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: No documented API for setting an individual agent's monthly Copilot Credit limit was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent monthly consumption limit set API Power Platform API pac admin PowerShell Dataverse; "bot" "EntityType" "consumption" "limit" Dataverse. Read returned CLI, bot-table, governance and capacity excerpts; no setter found.

claims.where: controls[1].scope and note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: The monthly limit is a general per-agent Copilot Studio consumption control, not a self-learning switch.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: The agent limit has an optional Stop usage hard stop.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls. Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately

claims.claim: Administrators can configure a notification threshold with the monthly agent limit.
claims.quote:
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
5. Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents in Power Platform admin center exposes agent credit consumption.
claims.quote:
On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. The Agents page appears where you can:

- Search for a specific agent.
- View all Copilot Studio agents across the tenant that incur billing charges.
- See configured copilot credit limits, if any.
- See month-to-date billed credits.

claims.fix: Replace 'That is the mechanism the roadmap item points to for lower cost, but the page does not describe this feature.' with 'This is general agent-flow billing background; the roadmap does not identify the type of workflow the feature will propose.'

claims.claim: The cited billing page lists an additional reasoning-model premium rate of 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.

claims.claim: On the standard-harness billing FAQ, the agent's own test-chat activity does not consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Building, testing, evaluating and running Microsoft Copilot harness agents can consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing. Building, testing, evaluating, and running these agents can consume Copilot Credits.
